client_intro: Thank you for booking a consultation with Creative Mark. A consultant will review your request and contact you to confirm the meeting.
next_2: We contact you to confirm this time or suggest another one.
next_3: You receive the meeting details by email.
keep_ref: Keep this reference number: it helps us find your request quickly.
reply_hint: To reply, simply answer this email.
footer_reason: You received this email because you booked a consultation on the Creative Mark website.
staff_intro: A new consultation has been booked on the website.
name: Name
staff_reply_hint: Replying to this email goes directly to the client.
story_intro: A scheduled story has just gone live on the website.
story_reason: You received this email because you can publish content on the Creative Mark website.
staff_link_subject: Choose a new password for the Creative Mark dashboard
staff_invite_intro: Creative Mark has added you to its dashboard as :role. Choose your password to start. Each time you sign in, we will email you a one-time code.
staff_link_intro: Use the button below to choose a new password for the Creative Mark dashboard.
staff_expires: This link works once and expires in :minutes minutes. If it expires, ask an administrator for a new one.
staff_ignore: If you did not expect this email, you can ignore it.
signin_subject: Your sign-in code for the Creative Mark dashboard
signin_intro: Use this code to finish signing in to the Creative Mark dashboard:
signin_expires: The code works once and expires in :minutes minutes.
signin_ignore: If you did not just try to sign in, change your password and tell an administrator.
recipient_subject: You will now receive Creative Mark booking notifications
recipient_intro: :by added this address to the people who receive an email for every new consultation booked on the Creative Mark website.
recipient_what: Each email shows the client’s details and the meeting time, with a button to open the booking in the dashboard. You can reply straight to the client.
recipient_ignore: If you should not receive these emails, ask an administrator to remove this address.
